source.text: Histologically or cytologically documented locally advanced, recurrent or metastatic cancer (esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, melanoma)
At least one measurable lesion( assessable lesion only accepted during accelerated titration stage) as per RECIST v. 1.1
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status (PS) of 0-1

Have clinically active central nervous system (CNS) metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis. Patients with previously-treated brain or meningeal metastases may participate and be eligible for treatment provided they are stable and asymptomatic.
Have clinically active central nervous system (CNS) metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis.
Have history of interstitial lung disease or non-infectious pneumonitis (except from radiotherapy);

Active autoimmune disease or history of autoimmune disease requiring systemic therapy \< 2 years prior to screening except hypothyroidism, vitiligo, Grave's disease, Hashimoto's disease, or Type I diabetes.
Use of systemic corticosteroids in a dose equivalent to \>10 mg/day of prednisone or other immunosuppressive agent \< 2 weeks prior to screening
Patients who have previously received allogeneic stem cell or solid organ transplantation.
Positive results for HIV test.
Active hepatitis B or C.

Cerebrovascular accident (CVA), transient ischemic attack (TIA), myocardial infarction (MI), unstable angina, or New York Heart Association (NYHA) class III or IV heart failure \< 6 months of study entry

Concurrent malignancy \< 5 years prior to entry other than adequately treated cervical carcinoma-in-situ, localized squamous cell cancer of the skin, basal cell carcinoma, localized prostate cancer, ductal carcinoma in situ of the breast, or \< T1 urothelial carcinoma.
should have progressed at least one prior systemic therapy regimen.
Tumor PD-L1 expression with a TPS≥1 %
